answer: New identities start as uncut pearls: each must complete three paid, audited work dives to earn a saffron-stamped pearl credential before it can trade at full volume, posting a 40,000 POA bond per dive. A wandering auditor - a random peer assigned after each dive - rechecks the work; fake work burns the dive bond, pays half to the auditor, and bans the identity for 8 epochs. Forging 1,000 fake pearls costs 1,000 x 120,000 = 120,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays only 120,000 POA once. Limitation: honest newcomers face a slow start while established agents trade freely.
